spells.notes: Caretaker holdover of the 전두환 government into the 노태우 term. Named on the afternoon of 1987-07-13 (중앙일보, 대통령기록관 일정 and 대한민국사연표 date the 개각 to 07-13) and given the 국무총리서리 임명장 on the morning of 1987-07-14, the start used here and on the OPM page. Assembly consent 1987-08-07 (likms 120431, 찬성 144, 반대 72, 기권 16 per 서울신문 1987-08-08). No separate 임명장 after consent was reported, so pm_acting_until follows the OPM page (서리 to 1987.08.06, 제19대 from 1987.08.07). 헌법 제10호 부칙 제4조① deems officials in office on 1988-02-25 appointed under the new constitution, so the spell runs into the window without a new appointment. The whole 5공 cabinet submitted a joint resignation at the last 국무회의 on 1988-02-24 (한국경제 1988-02-25) and 노태우 accepted it on the morning of 1988-02-25 before giving 이현재 the 임명장 (매일경제 1988-02-25, 조선일보 1988-02-26, 중앙일보 1988-02-25). End = the day the resignation was accepted, a same-day handover with 이현재. The OPM page ends him on 1988.02.24 (last full day). The joint 이·취임식 with 이현재 took place on 1988-02-26 (동아일보 1988-02-26). Gender from 동아일보 1987-07-14 ('부인 李姫載여사'), see gender_source. Birth date from the OPM profile (tier 2) only. [verifier] Start re-verified with 동아일보 1987-07-14 (임명장 on the morning of 07-14) and 조선일보 1987-07-14 (not yet given the 임명장 on the evening of 07-13). For the end, 동아일보 1988-02-24 reports the joint resignation handed in on 02-24 without acceptance, and 동아일보 1988-02-25 has 이현재 receiving his 임명장 at 11:40 on 02-25, so the last day is 02-24 or 02-25. The acceptance on the morning of 02-25 rests on the builder's 조선일보, 매일경제 and 중앙일보 reports. Consent tally corrected from the plenary minutes, see changes.

No 임명장 after consent was found. pm_acting_until follows the OPM page (서리 to 1991.01.22, 제22대 from 1991.01.23), which is two days after the vote, see issues. He submitted his resignation on 1991-05-22 during the crisis after 강경대's death (대한민국사연표 1991-05-22) and 노태우 accepted it on the morning of 1991-05-24, naming 정원식 서리 the same morning. Start and end are confirmed. The field pm_acting_until is disputed. Consent came on the evening of 1991-01-21 (plenary minutes, vote opened 18:52, 262 cast). pm_acting_until 1991-01-22 is kept because it follows OPM (tier 2, 서리 to 1991.01.22). Against it, the same minutes record him speaking as 국무총리 right after the vote, and 매일경제 and 동아일보 1991-01-22 title him 국무총리 for events on the morning and noon of 01-22. Start stays 1991-05-24, the appointment date in every official list and day-of report, because he exercised the PM's 제청 power before the 임명장. See issues. Consent 1991-07-08 (likms 131229, 찬성 203, 반대 65 per 한겨레 and 한국일보 1991-07-09). pm_acting_until follows OPM (서리 to 1991.07.07). He collected the cabinet's joint resignation on 1992-10-07 after 현승종 was named for the 중립선거관리내각, and held the joint 이·취임식 with 현승종 on the afternoon of 1992-10-08 after 현승종 received his 임명장 (서울신문, 한겨레 1992-10-09). Birth date from the OPM profile only. [verifier] Start re-verified with 한겨레, 조선일보 and 한국일보 1991-05-25. End kept at 1992-10-08 (successor's 임명장 at 16:00, 한국일보 1992-10-09). 경인일보 1992-10-08 has him handing the cabinet's joint resignation, his own included, to 노태우 on the afternoon of 10-07. 세계일보 1992-10-08 p.1 says the resignation was accepted on 10-07, but the same paper's editorial expects the resignations to be taken after the 10-08 consent, and 서울신문 1994-04-27 says that from 현승종 on the PM was appointed only after consent. spells.notes: Named (내정) on 1992-10-07 to lead the 중립선거관리내각 (대한민국사연표, 경향신문 1992-10-08). The motion was submitted the same day. Consent and 임명장 on 1992-10-08 (likms 140058, 찬성 266, 반대 9, 기권 1, 무효 1 per 경향신문 1992-10-09). He was never styled 서리 in the official list. One report calls him '현승종총리서리' on 1992-10-07 (세계일보 1992-10-08), which reads as loose usage for 내정자. He stayed in office past 노태우's term (ended 1993-02-24 24:00) until 김영삼 appointed 황인성 on the afternoon of 1993-02-25. 매일경제 1993-02-24 reports that ministers had no fixed term and that 현승종 would stay until 황인성 received his 임명장 and the 이취임식 was held. The 이·취임식 was on 1993-02-26 (조선일보 1993-02-27). End is the successor's appointment day. OPM prints 1993.02.24. Hanja 玄勝鍾 as printed in the newspapers (ko.wikipedia writes 玄勝種). Gender from 경향신문 1992-10-08 ('부인 洪榮杓(홍영표)여사'), see gender_source. Birth date from the OPM profile only. [verifier] Start kept at 1992-10-08 with pm_status 정식. Two same-day reports say 노태우 appointed him 총리서리 on the afternoon of 10-07 (한국일보 and 세계일보 1992-10-08, citing the 청와대 spokesman), and the builder called such reports loose usage after seeing only one of them. Against them are 서울신문 1992-10-08 (내정), the plenary minutes of 10-08 (the ballot names '현승종 씨', while the 1988-1991 ballots name the nominee 국무총리서리), the 대통령기록관 schedule (임명장 on 10-08 only), OPM (no 서리 row) and 서울신문 1994-04-27, which dates the end of the 서리 practice to 현승종. If the 10-07 서리 appointment were adopted, start would be 1992-10-07 with pm_acting_until 1992-10-07 and 정원식 would end on 10-07. End re-verified with 부산일보 and 서울신문 1993-02-26 (현승종 already 전 총리 at the 17:00 reception on 02-25). Status disputed. The value kept is the better-supported one, and the contrary sources are listed below and in verification.disputes. Contrary reports: 한국일보 1992-10-08 "중립내각 내일 출범/4∼5부처 장관 경질/새 총리에 현승종씨" (BigKinds news_id 01101101.19921008000000101, full text: '◎오늘 국회동의 절차/“선거법 철저히 집행”노태우대통령은 7일 하오 중립선거 관리 내각을 이끌 신임 국무총리 서리에 현승종 교총회장을 임명했다.', https://www.bigkinds.or.kr/news/detailView.do?docId=01101101.19921008000000101&returnCnt=1&sectionDiv=1000, accessed 2026-09-26T13:48:59-0400; snapshot roster/sources/pm/ext88_verify/bigkinds/art_01101101.19921008000000101.json) | 세계일보 1992-10-08 "고사 거듭하다 “나라위해 희생” 결단/현승종씨 새 총리 임명 안팎" (BigKinds news_id 01100701.19921008000000301, full text: '김대변인은 이날 오후4시40분쯤 현총리서리의 임명사실을 발표하면서 『현총리서리가 어제 왜 총리직을 고사했느냐』는 질문에 『9·18선언의 역사적 뜻을 높이 평가하고 이번 선거가 전에 없이 공명선거가 돼야 한다는 점을 인식,자신의 힘이 모자란다는 뜻에서 겸양지', https://www.bigkinds.or.kr/news/detailView.do?docId=01100701.19921008000000301&returnCnt=1&sectionDiv=1000, accessed 2026-09-26T13:49:50-0400; snapshot roster/sources/pm/ext88_verify/bigkinds/art_01100701.19921008000000301.json). spells.notes: 감사원장, named on 1993-12-16 after 황인성's resignation was accepted. The Assembly consented the same afternoon (찬성 220, 반대 36, 기권 2, 무효 2 per 국민일보 1993-12-17) and he received the 임명장 on the morning of 1993-12-17, followed by his 취임식 (경향신문 1993-12-18, 국민일보 and 세계일보 1993-12-17). 한겨레 1993-12-18 calls 12-17 the day of his formal appointment. The 대통령기록관 schedule, the 대한민국사연표 and 경향신문 1993-12-17 date the appointment to 12-16, see issues. Start is the 임명장 day, as on the OPM page. issues.desc: The 국무총리실 (opm.go.kr) list ends each PM on the day before the successor starts. Day-of reports place the handover a day later in nine places. They are 김정렬 (OPM 1988.02.24, resignation accepted 1988-02-25), 이현재 (1988.12.04, handover 12-05), 강영훈 (1990.12.26, 12-27), 노재봉 (1991.05.23, resignation accepted 05-24), 정원식 (1992.10.07, successor appointed 10-08), 현승종 (1993.02.24, 02-25), 이회창 (1994.04.21, resignation at 17:00 on 04-22), 이영덕 (1994.12.16, 12-17) and 이홍구 (1995.12.17, 12-18). This file follows the day-of reports, the same rule as pm.verified.json. OPM and the news agree for 황인성 (1993-12-16) and 이수성 (1997-03-04). ko.wikipedia copies the OPM dates except 이회창's end (04-22) and 이영덕's start (04-29).

정원식 start. He was appointed 국무총리서리 on 1991-05-24 while abroad and received the 서리 임명장 only on 1991-05-27 (동아일보 1991-05-27, 한겨레, 경향신문, 한국일보 1991-05-28). The start is 1991-05-24 because every official list and day-of report gives that date and because he exercised the PM's 제청 power on 1991-05-26 before the 임명장 (조선일보 1991-05-27). Under a strict 임명장 rule the start would be 1991-05-27, leaving 1991-05-25..26 without a PM.

이회창 start. The 대통령기록관 schedule, the 대한민국사연표 and 경향신문 1993-12-17 date his appointment to 1993-12-16, the day of the consent vote. 국민일보, 세계일보 and 경향신문 report the 임명장 on the morning of 1993-12-17, 한겨레 calls 12-17 the formal appointment, and OPM starts him on 1993.12.17. This file uses 1993-12-17 (임명장 day, the rule used for 고건 1997 in the main file). 1993-12-16 is possible if the 재가 preceded the ceremony. The same question applies to 김정렬 (named 1987-07-13, 임명장 1987-07-14).

노재봉 pm_acting_until. The Assembly consented on 1991-01-21, but OPM starts his 제22대 term on 1991.01.23 (서리 to 01.22). No report of a 임명장 or formal appointment on 01-21..23 was found. 중부매일 calls him 국무총리 on 01-23 and 한겨레 1991-01-22 already writes 노재봉총리 for the evening of 01-21. The value 1991-01-22 follows OPM. For 김정렬, 이현재, 강영훈 and 정원식 the OPM formal start equals the consent day.

이수성 birth date. The OPM profile prints 1937년 3월 10일. 매일경제 1995-12-16 writes '39년경북 칠곡출신', 한겨레, 조선일보 and 경향신문 give his age as 56 in December 1995, and ko.wikipedia (oldid 40553229) gives 1939. birth_date is set to the year 1939 only. The month and day are unverified.

이영덕 서리 status. A few 1994-04-23 reports call him 총리서리 (매일경제 '신임 李榮德총리서리', 서울신문 '신임리총리서리'), but 중앙일보 and 한겨레 1994-04-24 state that no 서리 appointment was made and that 정재석 acted as PM, and 국민일보 1994-04-27 says he was still formally 통일부총리. This file has no 서리 period for him and records 정재석 as acting 1994-04-22..04-29.
강영훈 consent tally. 동아일보 1988-12-16 prints 可160 否10 기권123. 중앙일보 1988-12-16 prints 가 160, 부 60, 기권 123, 무효 1, which sums to 344 against 재적 299. The tally uses 부 10.

Birth dates. For 강영훈, 노재봉, 황인성, 이회창 and 이홍구 the OPM date equals the NA ALLNAMEMBER date, which ALLNAMEMBER marks 음 (lunar). The OPM profile does not say which calendar it uses. For 김정렬, 이현재, 정원식, 현승종 and 이영덕 the OPM profile is the only source.

News Library quotes are from the site's OCR text and were not compared with the page images. Each date rests on at least two different newspapers, usually one from each archive, plus the OPM list or the 대통령기록관 schedule. The hanja 玄勝鍾 is as printed in the newspapers. ko.wikipedia writes 玄勝種.

Short vacancies without an acting record. On 1993-12-16 (after 황인성's resignation was accepted in the morning) and in the evening of 1997-03-04 (after 이수성 was replaced) no PM was in office until the successor's 임명장 the next morning. BigKinds searches for '총리 대행' on those days found no acting PM.

Nominations. 김종필's nomination by 대통령당선인 김대중 on 1998-02-23 falls in the window by date but belongs to the spell starting 1998-03-03 and is in pm.verified.json, so it is not repeated here. The withdrawn motion 국무총리(이한기)임명동의의건 (likms 120423, 1987-06-04, 철회 1987-08-05) belongs to 이한기's 서리 spell 1987-05-26..07-13, which ends before the window, and is only mentioned in 김정렬's nomination notes.

from_main spell 고건 (1997-03-05..1998-03-03) was copied unchanged. The sources gathered here agree with its start (임명장 on the morning of 1997-03-05 after consent on 03-04). ko.wikipedia (oldid 42269464, tier 4) lists 임창열 as '임시 직무대행' from 1998-02-25 to 03-05, which conflicts with the main file's day-of reports of 고건 serving until 1998-03-03.
